name: my-wallet
description: My Wallet (محفظتي) - AI-Powered Personal Finance & Hybrid Accounting SPA packaged with Capacitor.js

scripts.prepare:www: mkdir -p www && cp index.html app.js www/ && cp -r assets www/assets
scripts.cap:init: npx cap init "My Wallet" com.mywallet.app --web-dir www
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:android: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease

author: My Wallet Architecture Team
